ei.title: A dog's welfare and assistance dog training
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: A dog's welfare includes psychological as well as biological or physical matters. It is wrong to turn your dog into a permanently chained watchdog, since being permanently tethered and isolated are both contrary to a dog's psychological welfare. Not all morally questionable arrangements, though, involve clearly visible cruelty or neglect, and here a major vulnerability of the model of raising assistance dogs surfaces. Recently, the treatment of assistance dogs has been questioned. Some researchers point out that sometimes pups are raised in foster homes with a lot of family interaction and then moved to individual kennels for months in their final training stages. What does this dramatic change do to the youngsters? One of them also notes that assistance dogs may have a series of human handlers during their lives. Since the pups are selected for their sociability, they bond with their handlers. How emotionally painful, then, is such a series of moves from one human or family to another? These potential welfare concerns do not involve psychological abuse. While we would likely describe months of isolation in kennels in final training as a straightforward welfare violation, we might also wonder how many moves from one home to another also count. * tether (밧줄이나 사술로) 매다 ** kennel 개집, 개 사육장

questions.passage: A dog's welfare includes (A)[psychological / nutritional] as well as biological or physical matters. It is wrong to turn your dog into a permanently chained watchdog, since being permanently tethered and isolated are both contrary to a dog's psychological welfare. Not all morally questionable arrangements, though, involve clearly visible cruelty or neglect, and here a major vulnerability of the model of raising assistance dogs surfaces. Recently, the treatment of assistance dogs has been (B)[approved / questioned]. Some researchers point out that sometimes pups are raised in foster homes with a lot of family interaction and then moved to individual kennels for months in their final training stages. What does this dramatic change do to the youngsters? One of them also notes that assistance dogs may have a series of human handlers during their lives. Since the pups are selected for their sociability, they bond with their handlers. How emotionally painful, then, is such a series of moves from one human or family to another? These potential welfare concerns do not involve psychological abuse. While we would likely describe months of isolation in kennels in final training as a (C)[trivial / straightforward] welfare violation, we might also wonder how many moves from one home to another also count.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 개의 복지는 생물학적/신체적 측면뿐 아니라 '심리적' 측면을 포함한다. 최근 도우미견의 처우가 '문제 제기'되었다. 사육장에서의 수개월 격리를 '명백한' 복지 위반으로 묘사할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① psychological — questioned — straightforward: 원문 일치
❌ ② nutritional(영양의)은 원문 psychological(심리적)과 불일치
❌ ③ approved(승인된)는 원문 questioned(문제 제기된)의 반의어
❌ ④ trivial(사소한)은 원문 straightforward(명백한)와 의미 불일치
det.tip: psychological(심리적인), questioned(문제 제기된), straightforward(명백한, 솔직한)

questions.passage: A dog's welfare includes psychological as well as biological or physical matters. It is wrong to turn your dog into a permanently chained watchdog, since being permanently (A)[tethered / rewarded] and isolated are both contrary to a dog's psychological welfare. Not all morally questionable arrangements, though, involve clearly visible cruelty or neglect, and here a major (B)[advantage / vulnerability] of the model of raising assistance dogs surfaces. Recently, the treatment of assistance dogs has been questioned. Some researchers point out that sometimes pups are raised in foster homes with a lot of family interaction and then moved to individual kennels for months in their final training stages. What does this dramatic change do to the youngsters? One of them also notes that assistance dogs may have a series of human handlers during their lives. Since the pups are selected for their (C)[aggression / sociability], they bond with their handlers. How emotionally painful, then, is such a series of moves from one human or family to another? These potential welfare concerns do not involve psychological abuse. While we would likely describe months of isolation in kennels in final training as a straightforward welfare violation, we might also wonder how many moves from one home to another also count.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 영구적으로 '묶이고' 격리되는 것은 개의 심리적 복지에 반한다. 도우미견 양육 모델의 주요 '취약점'이 드러난다. 강아지들은 '사교성' 때문에 선발되어 사육사에게 유대감을 형성한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① rewarded(보상받은)는 원문 tethered(묶인)와 불일치. 맥락상 부정적 상황
✅ ② tethered — vulnerability — sociability: 원문 일치
❌ ③ advantage(장점)는 원문 vulnerability(취약점)의 반의어. 문맥상 부정적 문제점
❌ ④ aggression(공격성)은 원문 sociability(사교성)와 반대. bond(유대)와 어울리지 않음
det.tip: tethered(묶인), vulnerability(취약점), sociability(사교성)

questions.passage: A dog's welfare includes psychological as well as biological or physical matters. It is wrong to turn your dog into a permanently chained watchdog, since being permanently tethered and isolated are both (A)[beneficial / contrary] to a dog's psychological welfare. Not all morally questionable arrangements, though, involve clearly visible cruelty or neglect, and here a major vulnerability of the model of raising assistance dogs surfaces. Recently, the treatment of assistance dogs has been questioned. Some researchers point out that sometimes pups are raised in foster homes with a lot of family (B)[interaction / competition] and then moved to individual kennels for months in their final training stages. What does this dramatic change do to the youngsters? One of them also notes that assistance dogs may have a series of human handlers during their lives. Since the pups are selected for their sociability, they bond with their handlers. How emotionally (C)[pleasant / painful], then, is such a series of moves from one human or family to another? questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 묶이고 격리되는 것은 개의 심리적 복지에 '반하는' 것이다. 위탁 가정에서 많은 가족 '교류'와 함께 양육된다. 한 사람에서 다른 사람으로 옮기는 것이 감정적으로 얼마나 '고통스러운'가?
det.analysis:
❌ ① beneficial(이로운)은 원문 contrary(반하는)와 반대. 묶이고 격리되는 것이 복지에 이롭다는 의미가 되어 문맥 모순
❌ ② competition(경쟁)은 원문 interaction(교류)과 불일치. 위탁 가정의 긍정적 환경 묘사와 안 맞음
✅ ③ contrary — interaction — painful: 원문 일치
❌ ④ pleasant(즐거운)는 원문 painful(고통스러운)의 반의어. 복지 우려의 맥락과 반대
det.tip: contrary to(~에 반하는), interaction(교류, 상호작용), painful(고통스러운)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 dramatic(극적인)인데 minor(사소한)로 바꿈. 위탁 가정에서 사육장으로의 변화가 '극적인' 변화라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① isolated(격리된): 영구적으로 묶이고 '격리된' 것이 복지에 반한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② minor(사소한) → dramatic(극적인): 가정에서 사육장으로의 변화가 새끼들에게 미치는 영향을 묻는 맥락이므로 minor는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ selected(선발된): 사교성 때문에 '선발된다'는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ bond(유대감을 형성하다): 사교성으로 선발된 강아지가 사육사에게 '유대감을 형성한다'는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: dramatic(극적인, 충격적인) ↔ minor(사소한)

det.korean: 원문은 violation(위반)인데 benefit(이득)으로 바꿈. 사육장에서 수개월 격리를 명백한 복지 '위반'으로 묘사할 수 있다는 문맥.

✅ ① wrong(잘못된): 개를 묶어두는 것이 '잘못된' 일이라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② neglect(방치): 잔인함이나 '방치'를 수반한다는 맥락에 적절

❌ ④ benefit(이득) → violation(위반): 사육장에서의 수개월 격리를 복지 '위반'으로 묘사한다는 부정적 맥락이므로 benefit은 문맥에 반대

det.korean: 원문은 moved(옮겨진)인데 returned(되돌아온)로 바꿈. 위탁 가정에서 양육된 후 사육장으로 '옮겨진다'는 문맥. 돌아온 것이 아니라 처음 보내진 것.

✅ ④ selected(선발된): 사교성 때문에 '선발된다'는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: moved(옮겨진) vs returned(되돌아온): moved는 새 장소로의 이동, returned는 원래 장소로의 복귀

det.korean: 개의 '복지'는 심리적, 생물학적, 신체적 측면을 포함한다. 글 전체가 '복지(welfare)' 관련 주제.
det.analysis:

❌ ③ training(훈련): 후반 훈련 과정 설명의 단어이지 첫 문장의 핵심어 아님
❌ ④ sociability(사교성): 강아지 선발 기준이지 글의 주제어 아님

det.korean: 모든 도덕적으로 의심스러운 조치가 명확히 눈에 보이는 '잔인함'이나 방치를 수반하는 것은 아니다.

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 raise의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 raise는 '제기하다(bring up an issue)'. (B)의 raise는 '양육하다, 기르다(bring up a child/animal)'.

✅ ① (A) 제기하다 — (B) 양육하다: (A)는 법정에서 문제를 '제기하다', (B)는 강아지/가축을 '기르다'
❌ ② (A) 양육하다 — (B) 제기하다: 의미가 뒤바뀜

emotion → ____
